visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) High-angle drone shot reveals a long, curved concrete embankment lined with vibrant yellow flowering trees in full bloom. A few small figures walk along the paved path on top of the levee. The background shows green farmlands and distant industrial buildings under a hazy blue sky. (2) Medium shot of a woman with long dark hair wearing a white textured long-sleeve dress walking away from the camera on an asphalt road. She turns her head to smile warmly, with yellow flowers framing the right side of the shot. (3) A sequence of aerial views shows the winding river and the dense line of yellow trees. A man in a dark blazer and a woman in the white dress stand together outdoors, speaking toward the camera with joyful expressions and squinting eyes against the sunlight. (4) Extreme close-ups of the yellow flowers show their ruffled, trumpet-like texture and red-veined throats. The woman is seen running and spinning among the trees, her white dress flowing, occasionally holding a black hat. (5) The scene shifts to a crowded outdoor food stall under a red and white striped canopy. An elderly woman wearing a pink apron and a green mask prepares food. The main female character is shown sitting at a table, using chopsticks to eat a glazed meatball from a paper bowl. (6) Close-up shots of food preparation show a large metal pot of soup and a plate of crispy fried fritters being cut. The man and woman are seen taking bites, reacting with wide eyes and exaggerated chewing. (7) Final drone shot pulls back from the woman walking on the path, revealing the scale of the yellow flower-lined levee and the adjacent green fields.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-tempo acoustic guitar and piano BGM sets a bright, rhythmic tone. A female narrator speaks with high pitch and enthusiastic energy, describing a romantic spring outing. (2) A sharp mechanical click sound transitions to a male voice talking in a conversational tone about a long-awaited trip. (3) Female narration resumes with soft string textures added to the BGM. Minimal wind noise is audible in the background. (4) A metallic clinking sound of a spoon hitting a bowl occurs as the female narrator shifts to a high-arousal tone while describing food. (5) A distinct liquid splashing sound followed by a steam-like hiss accompanies the mention of soup. (6) A sharp crunching sound marks a bite into a crispy fritter. The female narrator's voice exhibits high pitch variability and playful intonation. (7) Both male and female voices join for a final energetic sign-off over the swelling BGM chords.
